ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by dominant high-intensity white pixels (approx. 70%) in the central medial regions and low-intensity black pixels (approx. 30%) defining the outer margins and leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pigmentation zone covering the majority of the visible ventral surface; dark pigmentation banding along the lateral and distal margins; small low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) visible in the upper medial section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal vertex angle of 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; right lobe trailing edge displays lower-frequency undulations with a distinct stepped notch near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex elliptical curve along the leading edges, tapering sharply at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, circular, elevated pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the leading edge and distal tip of the left lobe, and the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and missing tissue segments along the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating major physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of protruding, non-planar biological attachments (stalked barnacles) visible on the leading edge of the left lobe.
